postings.title: (Senior) Account Executive Austria (m/w/d)
postings.description:
Für den österreichischen Markt suchen wir eine erfahrenen Account Executive, der den Aufbau von Grund auf liebt.  - Solution Selling: Du identifizierst die spezifischen Probleme österreichischer SMEs, vermittelst den Wert der Risikominderung und erklärst, warum Eye die Lösung ist.

 - Wachstumschancen erkennen & realisieren: Du erkennst Chancen in Österreich und im regionalen Partnernetzwerk – und machst sie wahr.

 - Markenschaft: Du repräsentierst Eye auf Branchenevents, arbeitest mit Produkt- und Marketingteams zusammen und wirst zur Stimme von Eye Security in Österreich.



Dein Profil

 - Nachweisliche Erfahrung im Abschluss von SaaS- oder Software-Lösungen, gerne im Bereich Cyber Security

 - Ausgeprägte kundenorientierte Fähigkeiten in Bedarfsanalyse und Solution Sales

 - Erfahrung im Vertrieb von IT-Infrastrukturlösungen oder Managed Services; du kannst Kunden zeigen, warum es über Kostenersparnisse hinausgeht – Risikominderung und Geschäftskontinuität zählen

 - Vertrautheit mit strukturierten Vertriebsmethoden (MEDDPICC) und deren Anwendung

 - Proaktive Mentalität, starkes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und die Fähigkeit, Dinge vorantreiben

 - ·Fließend Deutsch (Wort und Schrift) und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse (Firmensprache ist Englisch)

 - Reisebereitschaft ca. 40 % - lokal in Österreich sowie innerhalb der DACH-Region



Was wir bieten

 - Du baust einen neuen Markt auf. Das ist mehr als ein Job – es ist eine Chance, von Anfang an zu prägen.

 - Schlüsselrolle im Wachstum: Du spielst eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau eines innovativen Cyber Security-Angebots, das Cybersicherheit mit Cyberversicherung verbindet.

 - Attraktives Vergütungspaket mit performancegebundenem Bonus

 - Car Allowance und flexible Urlaubstage für zusätzliche Freizeit

 - MacBook oder Windows-Laptop + iPhone oder Samsung-Firmenhandy

 - Umfassende Unterstützung für deine persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung

 - Regelmäßige Treffen mit dem Team – Gelegenheit zur persönlichen Zusammenarbeit und zum Aufbau starker Beziehungen



Über Eye

Eye Security ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Scale-ups Europas im Bereich Cyber Security und Cyber Insurance. Wir bauen unseren Markt in Österreich auf – und wir suchen dich, um das zu schaffen.

Mit über 180 Mitarbeitern europaweit und starkem Wachstum in der DACH-Region haben wir bewiesen, dass unsere Lösung funktioniert. Jetzt ist es an der Zeit, den österreichischen Mittelstand zu schützen.

Wir setzen neue Maßstäbe: Durch die Kombination von Spitzentechnologie und praktischem Fachwissen bieten wir dem europäischen Mittelstand Echtzeit-Schutz vor Cyberbedrohungen – auf dem neuesten Stand der Technik. Unser Team vereint Fachleute aus Geheimdiensten, Militär, Technologie und Beratung – alle getrieben von einer gemeinsamen Mission: Enterprise-Level-Cybersicherheit für jeden Mittelständler zugänglich zu machen, nicht nur für Großkonzerne.

Du bist nicht nur Teil eines wachsenden Unternehmens – du baust für uns einen neuen Markt auf.



Möchtest du dein Fachwissen für etwas einsetzen, das wirklich etwas bewirkt – und dabei einen Markt aufzubauen? Dann freuen wir uns auf dich!

postings.title: HR Business partner
postings.description:
People Business Partner

Most HRBP roles ask you to run processes someone else built. This one asks you to build them, inside the part of the business where cybersecurity actually happens, with managers who are still learning to lead and specialists who know exactly how rare they are. If you need a mature organization around you to do your best work, this isn't it. If you get energy from building one, keep reading.


The role
You'll be the People Business Partner for our core business: security operations, incident response, customer support & on boarding, and project management. It's the most varied population in the company: working students running shift rosters next to deeply specialized senior engineers, and managers at very different stages of their leadership journey. 

That mix is exactly why this role needs presence more than years. You'll coach first-time managers on the basics one hour and challenge C-level on a strategic call the next. You'll need to be comfortable doing both, and to enjoy it.

And here's what makes this role bigger than the title: alongside the partnering work, you'll get to build things most HRBPs only inherit: redesigning our performance cycle, rethinking benefits, shaping how development works here. STAFF AI SECURITY ENGINEER (F/M/X)




WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

AI is changing both the scale of cyber threats and how defenders operate. Eye Security wants to use modern AI and agentic systems to make SecOps more effective and solve cybersecurity problems across our customer base that cannot scale through manual work alone.

We are hiring a Staff AI Security Engineer to champion AI security as a discipline at Eye Security, independently explore these opportunities, build working prototypes and help turn successful experiments into production capabilities. Initial focus areas include Agentic SOC, AI-driven vulnerability hunting and the security of our own AI systems.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Expand Agentic SOC capabilities. Work directly with SecOps analysts to identify high-value investigation, triage and response workflows that can be improved through AI. Prototype agents, evaluate them against real operational cases and measure their effect on analyst quality, speed and workload.

 - Develop Agentic Workflows at scale. For example, research and prototype agentic systems that help Eye identify relevant vulnerabilities, validate exposure and exploitability, develop detection logic and prioritise action across customer environments.

 - Translate prototypes into customer-facing capability & tools. Actively explore with customers and partners the possibility of turning a prototype into a shippable tool, something that solves a real problem, like browser extensions (we have three to date), agentic skills, and other tools.

 - Help secure Eye’s AI systems. Assess agentic, LLM and RAG systems for realistic risks such as prompt injection, unsafe tool use, data leakage and supply-chain exposure, and turn findings into practical engineering controls.

 - Work closely with the Principals in your team. You will be part of a team that has hands-on AI expertise and emphasizes cooperation and mutual exchange.

 - Work across the organization. Work with internal teams to get findings and mitigations into shipped systems, and understand where AI-related incidents and threats are already showing up operationally.

 - Exposure: write up technical research for our Eye Research blog and represent Eye Security externally through talks and technical content on AI security.

 - Track the threat landscape. Stay ahead of emerging attack techniques against LLM and agentic systems, and emerging guidance (OWASP, NIST, ENISA) on how to defend against them, translating that into something Eye Security can act on.
   
   


IN YOUR FIRST 6–12 MONTHS

 - Write & execute a 100-day plan with input from the Research & Innovation team and the CTO.

 - Work together towards an Agentic SOC prototype and/or AI-driven CVE hunting capability that demonstrates a measurable improvement in analyst efficiency or investigation quality.

 - Complete a security assessment of at least one production AI system and help implement the resulting controls. Establish a working definition of "AI security review" at Eye Security.

 - Publish research or tooling when it creates meaningful value for customers or the wider security community.
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong hands-on cybersecurity experience. You have worked directly in one or more areas such as SOC operations, incident response, threat detection, vulnerability research, offensive security or security engineering.

 - Staff-level technical judgment. You can independently identify valuable research questions, decide what is worth pursuing, communicate your reasoning and influence engineers and security specialists without formal authority. Comfort in building things yourself. You can go from a research question to a working prototype largely independently.

 - Demonstrable hands-on interest in AI. You have built or experimented with LLMs, agents, RAG or related systems through professional work, independent research, open-source contributions or substantial personal projects.

 - Working proficiency in English. Dutch or German is a plus, not a requirement.
   
   


BONUS POINTS

 - Prior offensive security experience (pentesting, red teaming, vulnerability research) that transfers to the AI/LLM domain. Background in SOC operations, MDR, or incident response.

 - Contributions to the AI security community: CTF write-ups, published jailbreaks or mitigations, OWASP LLM Top 10 or MITRE ATLAS involvement, conference talks.

 - Experience with managed LLM platforms (e.g. Bedrock)
   
   


ABOUT THE RESEARCH & INNOVATION TEAM


The R&I team at Eye Security works on problems that sit just ahead of the MDR, Incident Response, and Threat Hunting teams. That research work includes designing agentic and LLM-assisted tooling, performing offensive and vulnerability research, or investigating threat tradecraft that is relevant when it comes to protecting our customers and the platforms they rely on.

With significant freedom to explore and build, the team investigates emerging areas of cybersecurity to help Eye Security stay ahead of evolving threats.
Much of the work we do is published on research.eye.security http://research.eye.security, and we present at conferences and industry events such as BlackHat https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sWV_3k-_S7Y.



WHAT WE OFFER
